== SWCCG Day 2008 results thread added, 24 November 2026 ==
Sources used (swccg-guild/work#1326):
* [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=22101 SWCCG Day 2008 Results] (Players Committee forum, 28–29 July 2008; 28 posts, read live on forum.starwarsccg.org). No Internet Archive capture exists yet; the citations carry no Preserved copy until one is made.
* [https://web.archive.org/web/20100505221437/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewforum.php?f=348 "&#91;General&#93; 2008 Tournament Discussion &amp; Results" board index] (swccgpc.com, capture 5 May 2010): shows the thread, started by simone89, with 27 replies.
* Handles tied to names from existing wiki pages: deadbody = [[Garrett Larson]], LCJK = [[Lee Clarke]], The Franchise = [[Brad Eier]], Psychobabble = [[Jeremy Jose]], imrahil327 = [[Chris Schoenthal]], mikefrench = [[Mike French]], mserisman = [[Michael Erisman]]. Cedric's reply to "garretts best of 33" also ties deadbody to Garrett.
Missing data:
* Winners of every reported event except Seattle; places of the events reported by Garrett Larson and Chris Schoenthal (both are Minnesota players on other pages, but the thread does not say where their events were held).
* Exact dates: the posts say "this weekend". Whether each event counted as a Worldwide SWCCG Day event is not stated; GadoTheLion asked "It was the Louisiana states, does that count?" and got no answer in the thread.
* Whether Worldwide SWCCG Day was held again after 2008: no later Players Committee news post, forum thread or other source has been found. The 5 May 2010 capture of the 2008 tournament board still lists only the 2008 thread.
* The flyer (Resources/wwswccg_flyer.pdf) and the V16 preview PDF linked from "V-16 Spoiler 1" have no Internet Archive capture.
* David Beabier (Seattle, 11th) has no wiki page.
To check:
* The Seattle post headed its results "Game by game results for Seattle - Round 4" with "league pts"; whether this was a round of the 2008 Players Committee League program is not stated, so the article says "Seattle league" only. [[Michael Erisman|Mserisman]] is a separate page that looks like a duplicate of [[Michael Erisman]].
* Alden Peterson (_maul) and Garrett Larson (deadbody) also replied about the New Jersey State Championship; their replies read as jokes and were not used. The count of 11 comes from the post by Advocate.

== Worldwide SWCCG Day promotional flyer recovered, 25 November 2026 ==
* Recovered <code>Resources/wwswccg_flyer.pdf</code> live at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/wwswccg_flyer.pdf https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/wwswccg_flyer.pdf] (4,282,525 bytes; PDF metadata dated 22 July 2008) and saved it to the Internet Archive: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125153912/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/wwswccg_flyer.pdf Internet Archive]. (Because the PDF is 4.28 MB and exceeds the wiki's 2 MB upload limit, it is cited via <code>res.starwarsccg.org</code> and the Internet Archive copy rather than uploaded to <code>File:</code>.)
* The flyer depicts the same four Virtual Set 16 preview cards listed in "V-16 Spoiler 1" (<code>Coruscant: Night Club</code>, <code>Jedi Survivor</code>, <code>Myn Kyneugh (V)</code>, and <code>Katana</code>).
* <code>Resources/V16_Preview.pdf</code> remains 403 Forbidden on <code>res.starwarsccg.org</code> and has no Internet Archive capture.
